steps.text: Theresa holds the hands of the one before her, as if it were their first meeting.
She quietly faces the other pair of eyes, looking at the emotions shifting within until finally, only a void remains.
She knows then, every memory has been wiped clean, the soul purified.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Your memory is gone, and your soul reborn...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: A truly terrible trick...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But they underestimate your benevolence, your desire for victory. They underestimate us, and what makes Terra so tenacious.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor. Allow me to call you by this name for the last time...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is my little revenge on you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And also... my final gift to you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Memory does not shape who you are. So, with your original self...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Live again... on this land. See the world, feel the various emotions life brings, meet the many people of Terra...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Perhaps... your journey will start in suffering, and you may never manage to escape the murky moon shadows of this land, but you will always... get to see the sun rise.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I trust you will find a new solution. One that is truly your own.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: An answer that... sounds just like the murmur Kal'tsit and I once heard...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: A most moving answer.
Life slips away.
Her ears gradually pick up an elegy from afar. Laqeramaline did establish a connection with her after all.
Theresa feels her own breath growing feebler, but she also feels unprecedentedly relieved.
She tries her best to keep Amiya in her arms, protected. Amiya's heartbeat calms her own.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'm... a little tired. It's exhausting, holding onto that crown.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I should rest when I'm tired. Isn't that right, Amiya?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I once imagined that...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Perhaps, one day... We'll be able to let everyone on this vast land fall into peaceful slumber.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It may take a long time to come, but maybe, you could see it for me...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Amiya, when you wake up...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You'll have to keep going.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: *sigh*—I'm so tired...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No, she's not here yet...
She clings to her final strand of remaining strength.
She is waiting for someone she must see.
Fortunately, the sound of her footsteps already draws near.
And then finally, even though she no longer has the strength to keep her eyes open, she knows—
She is here—
Kal'tsit...
Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya... Doctor...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I knew full well this possibility always existed... Why...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I should have stayed behind—it's my...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The...resa.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I... We should have...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa... confirmed... dead.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, heed my command...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Prepare... for any follow up attacks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Doctor and Amiya... nothing must happen to them. Protect them at all costs!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr—!
Kal'tsit...
Kal'tsit.
Amiya opens her eyes, pink rhombuses faintly visible in her pupils.
Theresa's eyes remain shut tight.
But Kal'tsit knows.
It's her.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Kal'tsit... I've been waiting for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa! I—

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: It's alright, Kal'tsit. It's fine.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Listen to me—

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: I'm already dead.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: What you see now is my consciousness put into the crown. I'm borrowing the body of this girl to bid you farewell.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Kal'tsit, tell me. Did you raise Babel's banner high up in the sky over Kazdel?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I sent it back to Kazdel, and watched it ascend myself...

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I came back too late, I knew there might be a possibility...

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Don't blame yourself for this, Kal'tsit. You had your own mission to fulfil.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: And... I managed to hold this long for you, and that's enough.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Are we, running out of time to say our goodbyes?

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: I'm sorry, Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Please don't blame yourself for this.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: We trusted the Doctor, and I hope you can continue on our path into the future.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Kal'tsit, there's no need for any further misgivings.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: I took a life, but I also saved it.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: So please, take it to where it should be, if it can wake again...

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Guide it, and it will in turn lead us to the end of our path—

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: I have no doubt about that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However... we can no longer take the risk of venturing into... the depths of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will entrust someone I know to send the Doctor to Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Chernobog will be safe. It is too... dangerous to allow the Doctor to stay on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: That's good... Kal'tsit. I'll leave the rest to Amiya then.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: She will walk a difficult road.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will be with her, and Babel... as well.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: She is so young, but so strong.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Kal'tsit, giving the crown to Babel... to her, I did not do this on a selfish whim.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: To break the cycle and deal with what is to come... The King cannot only be a King of the Sarkaz, nor can it only be a King of Terra.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: The role is no fetter, controller, or unparalleled power.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: The role is a key. The King is... 'Civilight Eterna'.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: But Kal'tsit, keep this a secret from Amiya. She doesn't need to bear all of that now.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: She will understand once she embarks on that path, she needs to understand—

spans.text: She will understand once she embarks on that path, she

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Only by overcoming every obstacle can we find the doors that lead to this world.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...And you?

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: I will be gone in the pursuit of my ideal. As for her...

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: She will become the flame that burns all corruption to ashes.

a.text: 'Kal'tsit, a new war is about to begin.'
'He will descend unto the cradle in Victoria that belongs to us, and Originium will cover that patch of land...'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: She is leaving us.

a.text: 'He will bring suffering to the other races on this land...'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: While you will become the final struggle for her ideals.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: A last-ditch effort.

a.text: 'He will make everyone else on Terra see the Sarkaz as enemies once more.'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Deathmongers—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Do not attempt to abandon your efforts, before her end is set...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Prove to me that her path still holds the chance to win a future—

a.text: 'Prevent that day from turning true, before everything becomes irreversible...'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Prove to her the peace you strive for is still worth a response.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Though I regret to say this, my compatriots...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The call to repay this blood debt is already resonating throughout this great land—

a.text: 'Kazdel's hatred should not continue to spread.'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Her death has been determined.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You have lost a Sarkaz King.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I have lost my only kin.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: And I will not let these sacrifices be in vain.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: My people—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Whether you've come for peace or vengeance—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I will hear your voices.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You will see where the Sarkaz's true path lies.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The blood with which you stain the steps of Victoria will eventually return to where it belongs—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: We must make this place a new beginning for us.

a.text: 'I can still hear the Sarkaz voices even now, Kal'tsit...'
'The closer I get to the myriad souls, the clearer their voices become.'
'What I can glean from their shouts and cries is—'

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Suffering will descend once more—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: All of Terra will surrender—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Starting from this very spot.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The Sarkaz—

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: —Will rise again.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: We have to stop him, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But... that's not something Babel can do, as it is now.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: You'll find a way.

steps.name: 'Amiya'
steps.text: Besides, you'll never be alone. With the Babel we built together—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Your Highness—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Theresa...! Your Highness...! Your Highness!

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...Your Highness...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I'm back, Your Highness...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You would always welcome me back here when I returned.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: But this time... you're not here.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Can you still hear me...?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Why couldn't you wait a little longer...?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...Damn it! Damn it all!

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I'll make them pay... this I swear to you.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Every single one...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Even if it's... even if—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Master... Theresis—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Theresis...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: He must face me... I... I have to find him!

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: All traitors... will suffer...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Your Highness Theresa... Theresis...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: My... only two... I couldn't...
Clouds cover the setting sun, and Ascalon is shrouded in shadow.
She has lost her light, her faith, forever.
She struggled. She strived.
Only death remains for the one born in the storm.

a.text: 'They are the most remarkable of all.'

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...Logos.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We... I don't know... we should...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Let's retreat first.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Let's... return to Babel.

a.text: 'They will never doubt our ideals, even for a second.'

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: ...It's over.

steps.name: Nezzsalem
steps.text: Why...? Why I feel...

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: I too am baffled, King of the Nachzehrers.

steps.name: Duq'arael
steps.text: I thought I was long accustomed to a King of Sarkaz's demise.

a.text: 'Those—the ones left behind, you do not need to question their loyalty.'

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...No way.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who sent this *Sarkaz expletive* comm? Did the Military Commission intercept this? Are they screwing with us?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't believe it... I... Shut the hell up! Scout!

steps.name: W
steps.text: The landship... should be this way!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Theresa... she couldn't have just... died like that!!
Winter of 898, The King of Sarkaz dies.
Yliš dies and Kazdel falls into ruin.
The explosion of the Soul Furnace sends dust flying all across Kazdel's territory for three whole days and nights...
Finally, it falls to the ground like black snowflakes.
Burying the bones of the invaders.
Along with the ruin once known as 'Kazdel'.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Kazdel... is no more.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But Kazdel has never been gone for good.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That's what I heard from the King of Sarkaz. He said Kazdel has met with ruin more than three thousand times, but it will always eventually be rebuilt anew.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Perhaps that was just a ploy by Yliš to deceive the people.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: He's dead, Theresis.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But even if it were only a tale he spun while wasting away in the palace... I could, at the very least, sense a strand of longing from his stories.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: A yearning for a stable life.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What happens after victory? Now, everyone will only begin wandering the land once more...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Our people will praise us as heroes, but we can only return to ruins devoid of life.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What can we even do now?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Heroes'... Once this war is over, that title will be meaningless...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Also... I seem to have picked up the myriad souls whispering in my ear from a while ago...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Their voices are becoming even more distinct...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I don't know where the myriad souls hope to lead me...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I hear the same.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I dismissed it as a delusion brought on by the euphoria of victory... but it seems to be more than that.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The myriad souls beckon us.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then let's go, to wherever they beckon.
Yliš, King of Sarkaz, rests here for eternity.
Underneath a massive mountain of corpses.
In the far future, not a single soul will know there was once a King who died here.
He was so mediocre, so ordinary.
The Sarkaz do not remember the defeated.
In this war that changed their fate, the people will only remember the names of six incomparably dazzling heroes.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I remember this place... It was here we gathered to swear our oaths and join the battle, after Yliš's chariot was destroyed.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: This is where we started...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: A clothesmaker, and a guard.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Did you hear that, Theresis?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The myriad souls speak from under our feet...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: There it is.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: To think it was this small.
The crown.
With death as a witness—
As well as the myriad souls—
The twins raise the crown in unison.
The crown chooses the twins in return.
Atop the ruins, the myriad souls, whose existence remains uncertain, select two distinct hopes at a time.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: ...You should wear the crown, Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz is but an optimistic fantasy for the pitiful when history chooses to stay silent.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Indeed... we will change the Sarkaz's fate, with or without relying on an external force.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But in this age of despair, it will bring a glimmer of hope to our people.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: I'm not fit to be that hope bringer.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: My blade will cut our path forward. And you will lead the way.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The war has just ended. How long will we bear this crown?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Until we find a home again. Until the Black Crown swallows us into its suffering...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Until everyone under the same sky can fall into a peaceful slumber.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Lead the way forward', you said. Do you still remember that adventure of ours?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You held your sword and carried me...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: And you guided me through the bushes until we got home.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Allow me to crown you myself.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Theresis...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I swear this vow to every Sarkaz...
